name: Gerrig Bonegrip
summary: Gerrig Bonegrip is an unassuming dwarven shopkeeper tucked away in the shadowy corridors of Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern. Behind the counter of Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms, he quietly buys and sells esoteric texts concerning dark rituals and forgotten ancient powers.

sections.title: Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms
sections.body: Operating in the dingy recesses of the Forlorn Cavern, Gerrig Bonegrip appears to most citizens as just an eccentric purveyor of bizarre relics and forbidden lore. However, his humble shop serves a far darker function. Bonegrip is an active member of the nihilistic Twilight's Hammer cult, using his storefront to gather dangerous manuscripts and obscure texts relating to the Old Gods under the very noses of the Ironforge Senate and the High Seat.

sections.title: Collecting Forbidden Knowledge
sections.body: Gerrig actively enlists unwitting Alliance adventurers to retrieve ancient artifacts, such as the Lorgalis Manuscript lost deep within Blackfathom Deeps. Once these relics are in his hands, he transcribes and disseminates the profane knowledge directly to his cult brethren across Azeroth. Through subtle connections to shadowy associates like Skuerto and figures dealing with ancient primordial entities like Myzrael, Bonegrip works tirelessly to advance the cult's apocalyptic designs.

faq.answer: Gerrig Bonegrip is a dwarf running Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern. He deals in eccentric curiosities and obscure texts concerning ancient rituals.

faq.q: What does he do with the Lorgalis Manuscript?
aliases: why does bonegrip want lorgalis manuscript
knowledge in the deeps turn in
faq.answer: He seeks the Lorgalis Manuscript from Blackfathom Deeps for his collection of rare texts. Further investigation can uncover more about his use of it.

faq.q: How does Gerrig operate in Ironforge?
aliases: does ironforge know bonegrip is a cultist
why is bonegrip allowed in ironforge
faq.answer: Gerrig maintains a low profile as an eccentric scholar and merchant in the Forlorn Cavern, where he buys and sells obscure texts.

faq.q: What is his connection to Myzrael?
faq.answer: Gerrig is an old associate of the dwarf Skuerto, who investigates the sealed earth elemental Myzrael in the Arathi Highlands. Through these connections, Gerrig helps orchestrate tasks tied to ancient binding rituals and primordial powers.

angles.text: Seeing a fellow dwarf pledge loyalty to apocalyptic Old God entities right in the heart of Ironforge's halls is a bitter reminder of how deeply the Twilight's Hammer can infiltrate.
For warlocks frequenting the shadowy corners of the Forlorn Cavern, Bonegrip's collection of esoteric rituals and dark tomes offers a convenient well of dangerous knowledge.
